Contributing to mysterymaps

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Before you write a function, look for it

This ecosystem has been bitten repeatedly by the same failure: the same helper written twice, load order deciding which one runs, and a fix applied to one copy being a fix applied to none. The failures are silent — no error, plausible output.

A cross-repo function index exists. Search it first:

awk -F'\t' 'tolower($1) ~ /jenks|legend|credential/ {printf "%-40s %s\n", $1, $2}' \
  ~/muffly-refs/FUNCTION_INDEX.tsv

Canonical homes:

Package Owns
mufflyaccess constants and safe arithmetic: bands, CONUS geography, safe_rate()
twostep E2SFCA accessibility, population-weighted coverage, access-language guard
mysterymaps map construction
isochrones routing, water masks, the isochrone pipeline
cliff workforce retirement modelling

If the capability genuinely does not exist, add it to the package that should own it. Do not keep a private copy and document why your caller is special — that argument is the one against every library improvement ever made.

Style

  • Exported functions are mysterymaps_*. Keep them free of any one study: a function that mentions midwives belongs in the study, not here.
  • Document why, not what. A comment that says what the next line does is noise; a comment that says which bug the line prevents is the reason anyone keeps it.
  • Guards error rather than filter. Silently dropping rows moves a denominator without anyone noticing.
  • Mapping packages are Suggests. Guard with requireNamespace().

Before opening a PR

devtools::document()   # NAMESPACE is generated — never hand-edit
devtools::test()
devtools::check()
Rscript data-raw/make_readme_figures.R   # if you changed map output

devtools::check() builds a PDF manual, so it needs LaTeX. BasicTeX is enough but ships without inconsolata, which Rd2pdf loads by default; without it the check fails at checking PDF version of manual with a LaTeX error that says nothing about fonts. Install it into your own tree, no sudo required:

tlmgr init-usertree
tlmgr --usermode install inconsolata

pdflatex lives in /Library/TeX/texbin on macOS, which a fresh non-login shell does not have on PATH — eval "$(/usr/libexec/path_helper)" if the check claims LaTeX is missing when it plainly is not.

NAMESPACE has twice silently stopped being roxygen-managed in this repo, once from a stray blank line above the # Generated by roxygen2 marker and once from a rebase conflict resolved by side-picking. Both times roxygen printed Skipping NAMESPACE, kept writing man pages, and R CMD INSTALL reported DONE with stale exports. If an export appears to vanish, check line 1 of NAMESPACE first, and regenerate generated files after a conflict rather than merging them by hand.

Reporting a bug

Include the map, or the code that builds it, and what you expected to see. Cartographic bugs are usually visible and rarely throw.
